headline: Browns DT Mason Graham Facing Short-Term Absence
summary: The Browns improved to 3-1 last night, but their defense was dealt a notable blow in the process. Mason Graham exited the game with a knee injury and did not return. The second-year defensive tackle was ruled out shortly after being injured. Following the game, Mary Kay Cabot of Cleveland.com noted Graham left the stadium on crutches […]

headline: Jets rule out RB Hall, WR Mitchell, TE Taylor, LG Parham vs. Bears
summary: Running back Breece Hall, wide receiver Adonai Mitchell, tight end Mason Taylor and left guard Dylan Parham were ruled out Friday for the Jets' road game against the Bears.

headline: Shoulder injuries sideline Gonzalez, Barmore as Pats ready for Bills
summary: The New England Patriots will be without starting cornerback Christian Gonzalez and defensive tackle Christian Barmore due to a shoulder injury when they visit the Bills on Sunday.

headline: Packers DT Warren Brinson to miss "significant time" with groin injury
summary: Packers defensive tackle Warren Brinson missed the first three games of the season with a calf injury and he's set to miss a lot more action with a new ailment.

headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) ruled out vs. Colts
summary: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels was ruled out of Sunday's game vs. the Colts, causing him to miss a second consecutive game because of a dislocated left elbow.

headline: Commanders To Start QB Marcus Mariota In Week 4
summary: Marcus Mariota helped the Commanders pull off an upset win in Week 3. He will be counted on as the team’s quarterback starter for at least one more game.
